anyOf.description: ApprovalRequest is a harness operation waiting for approval.

id.description: ID identifies this request within its turn.

tool.description: Tool names the operation awaiting approval.

input.description: Input is the approval payload encoded as JSON text.

anyOf.description: AssistantMessage is one complete prose message from an agent.

id.description: ID identifies this message within its turn.

text.description: Text is the complete assistant message.

anyOf.description: AssistantMessageDelta is the next fragment of an assistant message.

id.description: ID identifies the assistant message this fragment extends.

text.description: Text is the next fragment of the assistant message.

anyOf.description: HarnessError is an error reported by the harness while a turn is running.

error.description: Error is the error reported by the harness.

anyOf.description: NestedTranscript is a subagent transcript produced inside a tool call.

call_id.description: CallID identifies the tool call that started the nested agent.

transcript.description: Transcript is the nested harness transcript encoded as JSON text.

anyOf.description: Retry reports that the harness will attempt part of a turn again.

attempt.description: Attempt is the one-based attempt that will run next.

error.description: Error is why the preceding attempt did not complete.

anyOf.description: Thinking is one complete reasoning item exposed by a harness.

id.description: ID identifies this thinking item within its turn.

text.description: Text is the complete thinking item.

anyOf.description: ThinkingDelta is the next fragment of a reasoning item.

id.description: ID identifies the thinking item this fragment extends.

text.description: Text is the next fragment of the thinking item.

anyOf.description: ToolCall is one complete tool invocation.

call_id.description: CallID pairs the call with its input fragments and result.

tool.description: Tool is the harness's tool name.

input.description: Input is the complete tool input encoded as JSON text.

anyOf.description: ToolInputDelta is the next fragment of a tool call's input.

call_id.description: CallID identifies the tool call whose input this fragment extends.

input.description: Input is the next fragment of the tool input's JSON source text.

anyOf.description: ToolResult is one complete result of a tool call.

call_id.description: CallID identifies the completed tool call.

output.description: Output is the complete tool result encoded as JSON text.

anyOf.description: ToolResultDelta is the next fragment of a tool result.

call_id.description: CallID identifies the tool result this fragment extends.

output.description: Output is the next fragment of the tool result's JSON source text.

anyOf.description: Usage is a harness's token-usage payload for one model call.

data.description: Data is the harness's token-usage payload encoded as JSON text.

anyOf.description: UserMessage is one complete prompt or landed steer sent to an agent.

text.description: Text is the complete message sent to the agent.
